judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame and type names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `conversations`). It directly contradicts several explicit acceptance criteria: it returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when the store lacks `listFor` instead of an `UNSUPPORTED` error frame, omits the opt-in `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` flag, and allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation rather than restricting `limit` to integers 1–200. It also logs the raw error message on store failure (violating the security/GDPR requirement to not log store details) and leaves an untracked `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository. Finally, it misses updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, and makes `sessionStore` a required parameter on `createMessageHandler` which breaks existing 1-arg callers.
